distributionDays.rule: close <= -0.2% on volume above the prior session; latest 25 sessions; retired once a later close is 5% above it

followThroughDay.rule: day 1 = lowest close after a 6% drawdown from the 63-session closing high; follow-through = day 4+ close up 1.25% on volume above the prior session; a close under day 1 fails it

rallyDay.rule: day 1 = lowest close after a 6% drawdown from the 63-session closing high; follow-through = day 4+ close up 1.25% on volume above the prior session; a close under day 1 fails it
